text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running with my crush tomorrow! Too hyped 
to sleep, Daitaku Helios goes for a stroll 
and spots Daiichi Ruby and K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby speaks dead seriously, 
stating that tomorrow's race will prove 
the blood of her "clan." Seeing her 
resolve, Daitaku Helios...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mental breakdown over not even being on 
their radar! So, gotta win to get in their 
line of sight, right? Totally agreeing 
with Trai-pi's advice, she takes on the 
race!
